cards.gloss_en: a tool with a mesh used to separate fine from coarse
cards.ex_en: She used a sieve to remove lumps from the flour.
cards.ex_cn: 她用筛子筛去面粉里的结块。

cards.gloss_en: the dry outer covering of a seed or grain
cards.ex_en: We peeled the husk off the corn.
cards.ex_cn: 我们剥掉了玉米的外壳。

cards.gloss_en: to make cloth by crossing threads over and under
cards.ex_en: Her grandmother can weave beautiful cloth.
cards.ex_cn: 她奶奶会织漂亮的布。

cards.gloss_en: to twist fibres into thread
cards.ex_en: The women spin wool into yarn by hand.
cards.ex_cn: 妇女们用手把羊毛纺成线。

cards.gloss_en: a plain cotton cloth, often printed
cards.ex_en: The dress was made of cheap calico.
cards.ex_cn: 那条裙子是用廉价的印花棉布做的。

cards.gloss_en: turning a container upside down over something
cards.ex_en: He kept the fire in by whelming a pot over it.
cards.ex_cn: 他把锅倒扣在上面来保住火。

cards.gloss_en: a person who bakes cakes and pastries
cards.ex_en: The pastrycook filled the window with fresh cakes.
cards.ex_cn: 糕点师把橱窗摆满了新鲜蛋糕。

cards.gloss_en: covered with loose stones or shingle
cards.ex_en: We walked along the beachy shore.
cards.ex_cn: 我们沿着满是卵石的岸边走。

cards.gloss_cn: 重新修整(refit 的过去分词)
cards.gloss_en: repaired and made ready for use again
cards.ex_en: The old boat was refitted for the long trip.
cards.ex_cn: 那条旧船经过重新修整以备远航。

cards.gloss_cn: 预见到(foresee 的过去分词)
cards.gloss_en: known about before it happens
cards.ex_en: The storm could not have been foreseen.
cards.ex_cn: 这场风暴无法预见。

cards.gloss_en: bars used to lift or move heavy things
cards.ex_en: They used iron levers to move the rock.
cards.ex_cn: 他们用铁杠撬动石头。

cards.gloss_en: to dig away the earth beneath something
cards.ex_en: The workers tried to undermine the old wall.
cards.ex_cn: 工人们试图挖空旧墙的墙脚。

cards.gloss_en: to overcome a difficulty
cards.ex_en: She surmounted every problem on the way.
cards.ex_cn: 她克服了途中的每一个困难。

cards.gloss_en: made smaller in size or amount
cards.ex_en: The rain lessened as evening came.
cards.ex_cn: 傍晚时雨势减小了。

cards.gloss_en: cut roughly with heavy blows
cards.ex_en: He hacked at the branch with an axe.
cards.ex_cn: 他用斧头劈那根树枝。

cards.gloss_en: a hammer with a wooden head
cards.ex_en: He tapped the peg in with a mallet.
cards.ex_cn: 他用木槌把木钉敲进去。

cards.gloss_en: a tool with a sharp edge for cutting wood or stone
cards.ex_en: The carver shaped the wood with a chisel.
cards.ex_cn: 雕刻师用凿子给木头造型。

cards.gloss_en: force or effort used to achieve something
cards.ex_en: By dint of hard work he passed the exam.
cards.ex_cn: 凭着刻苦努力他通过了考试。

cards.gloss_en: a downward slope of the ground
cards.ex_en: The path ran down a gentle declivity.
cards.ex_cn: 小路沿着一道缓缓的下坡延伸。

cards.gloss_en: to give or allow something unwillingly
cards.ex_en: She did not grudge the time spent helping others.
cards.ex_cn: 她不吝惜帮助别人所花的时间。

cards.gloss_en: unwillingness to do something
cards.ex_en: He agreed at last, but with great reluctancy.
cards.ex_cn: 他最终同意了,但很不情愿。

cards.gloss_en: deep religious feeling and worship
cards.ex_en: She said her prayers with great devotion.
cards.ex_cn: 她怀着极大的虔诚祷告。

cards.gloss_en: goods loaded onto a ship
cards.ex_en: The ship's loadings were stacked on the deck.
cards.ex_cn: 船上的货物堆在甲板上。

cards.gloss_cn: 支配、决定(dictate 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: determined or directed how things should be
cards.ex_en: Necessity dictated every choice he made.
cards.ex_cn: 需要支配着他所做的每一个选择。

cards.gloss_en: eager to have what others have
cards.ex_en: His covetous eyes fixed on the gold.
cards.ex_cn: 他贪婪的目光盯着那些金子。

cards.gloss_en: a person who hoards money and hates spending
cards.ex_en: The old miser never gave a penny away.
cards.ex_cn: 那个老守财奴从不施舍一分钱。

cards.gloss_en: a strong greedy desire for wealth
cards.ex_en: His covetousness left him with no friends.
cards.ex_cn: 他的贪婪使他没有朋友。

cards.gloss_en: costing sixpence; of little value
cards.ex_en: He bought a sixpenny toy at the fair.
cards.ex_cn: 他在集市上买了个六便士的小玩具。

cards.gloss_en: a round root vegetable eaten as food
cards.ex_en: We pulled a large turnip from the garden.
cards.ex_cn: 我们从菜园里拔出一个大萝卜。

cards.gloss_en: not satisfied with what one has
cards.ex_en: He felt discontented with his small wages.
cards.ex_cn: 他对微薄的工资感到不满。

cards.gloss_en: feelings of dissatisfaction
cards.ex_en: Their discontents grew louder every day.
cards.ex_cn: 他们的不满一天比一天强烈。

cards.gloss_en: to bite at something again and again
cards.ex_en: The dog gnawed the old bone for hours.
cards.ex_cn: 狗啃了那根旧骨头好几个小时。

cards.gloss_en: to fill someone with a feeling or idea
cards.ex_en: The coach tried to infuse courage into the team.
cards.ex_cn: 教练努力给全队注入勇气。

cards.gloss_en: companions who eat together, as on a ship
cards.ex_en: The sailors shared their food with their messmates.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们和同伴一起分食物。

cards.gloss_en: feeling strong dislike and contempt for
cards.ex_en: He walked away, despising their empty promises.
cards.ex_cn: 他走开了,蔑视他们空洞的承诺。

cards.gloss_en: done regularly as a habit
cards.ex_en: Getting up early was habitual for him.
cards.ex_cn: 早起对他来说是习惯。

cards.gloss_en: to speak with disrespect about God or holy things
cards.ex_en: The crowd was shocked to hear him blaspheme.
cards.ex_cn: 众人听到他亵渎神明大为震惊。

cards.gloss_en: generously and in large amounts
cards.ex_en: The land provided bountifully that year.
cards.ex_cn: 那一年土地出产丰盛。

cards.gloss_en: to complain or feel discontent
cards.ex_en: He never repined at his hard luck.
cards.ex_cn: 他从不为自己的厄运抱怨。

cards.gloss_en: to feel or show great joy
cards.ex_en: The whole village rejoiced at the good news.
cards.ex_cn: 全村人为好消息欢欣鼓舞。

cards.gloss_en: large black birds like big crows
cards.ex_en: Two ravens circled above the cliff.
cards.ex_cn: 两只渡鸦在悬崖上盘旋。

cards.gloss_en: not fit for anyone to live in
cards.ex_en: The ruined house was completely uninhabitable.
cards.ex_cn: 那座破房子完全不能住人。

cards.gloss_en: made something last by using it sparingly
cards.ex_en: They eked out the water until rain came.
cards.ex_cn: 他们省着用水直到下雨。

cards.gloss_en: the happening of things at the same time
cards.ex_en: By a strange concurrence, both letters arrived together.
cards.ex_cn: 由于奇怪的巧合,两封信同时到了。

cards.gloss_cn: 发生、降临(befall 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: happened to someone, usually something bad
cards.ex_en: A great misfortune befell the family.
cards.ex_cn: 一场大不幸降临到这个家庭。

cards.gloss_en: in a way that shows belief in magic or omens
cards.ex_en: She superstitiously avoided walking under ladders.
cards.ex_cn: 她迷信地避开从梯子下走过。

cards.gloss_en: having two parts; twice as much
cards.ex_en: The plan had a twofold purpose.
cards.ex_cn: 这个计划有双重目的。

cards.gloss_en: causing a feeling of pity
cards.ex_en: The lost child gave a piteous cry.
cards.ex_cn: 迷路的孩子发出可怜的哭声。

cards.gloss_cn: 拙劣地、糟糕地;悲惨地、凄惨地
cards.gloss_en: very badly; or in a miserable, pitiful way
cards.ex_en: The shed was wretchedly built and soon fell.
cards.ex_cn: 那棚子盖得很糟,很快就塌了。

cards.gloss_en: farthest from the centre or inside
cards.ex_en: The outermost layer kept off the wind.
cards.ex_cn: 最外层挡住了风。

cards.gloss_en: a very small amount
cards.ex_en: He did not care a jot about the prize.
cards.ex_cn: 他对那奖一点也不在乎。

cards.gloss_en: not very well; in a mediocre way
cards.ex_en: The job was done rather indifferently.
cards.ex_cn: 这活儿干得相当马虎。

cards.gloss_en: the power to arrange or control something
cards.ex_en: He left everything to the disposal of fate.
cards.ex_cn: 他把一切交给命运安排。

cards.gloss_en: in a way shared by two sides
cards.ex_en: The two friends mutually agreed to help.
cards.ex_cn: 两个朋友相互约定互相帮助。

cards.gloss_en: matching or suited to something
cards.ex_en: His skill was not answerable to the great task.
cards.ex_cn: 他的本领与这项艰巨任务不相称。

cards.gloss_en: a cloth cover that gives shade from sun or rain
cards.ex_en: We sat under the awning to escape the sun.
cards.ex_cn: 我们坐在遮篷下躲太阳。

cards.gloss_en: the outer edge or boundary of a round area
cards.ex_en: They walked around the circumference of the lake.
cards.ex_cn: 他们绕湖的周边走了一圈。

cards.gloss_en: very dry from heat or thirst
cards.ex_en: The parched fields needed rain badly.
cards.ex_cn: 焦干的田地急需雨水。

cards.gloss_en: the period during which a ruler is in power
cards.ex_en: The country was peaceful during her reign.
cards.ex_cn: 在她统治期间国家很太平。

cards.gloss_en: a ridge of rock, often under water
cards.ex_en: The boat scraped against a hidden ledge.
cards.ex_cn: 小船擦过一处暗礁。

cards.gloss_en: seizing and struggling with something
cards.ex_en: The sailors were grappling with the heavy net.
cards.ex_cn: 水手们奋力抓着沉重的网。

cards.gloss_en: a fast rush of water, as through a gate
cards.ex_en: The water burst out like a sluice.
cards.ex_cn: 水像急流一样奔涌而出。

cards.gloss_en: in a way that cannot be got back or undone
cards.ex_en: The letter was irrecoverably lost at sea.
cards.ex_cn: 那封信在海上无可挽回地丢失了。

cards.gloss_en: not feeling or showing gratitude
cards.ex_en: It was unthankful of him to complain.
cards.ex_cn: 他抱怨真是不知感恩。

cards.gloss_en: much loved and dear to someone
cards.ex_en: He returned at last to his beloved home.
cards.ex_cn: 他终于回到了心爱的家。

cards.gloss_en: an imaginary line running north to south on the earth
cards.ex_en: The ship crossed the meridian at noon.
cards.ex_cn: 船在正午越过了子午线。

cards.gloss_en: to drive or push back
cards.ex_en: The current repulsed the little boat again.
cards.ex_cn: 水流又一次把小船推了回去。

cards.gloss_en: of wind, becoming stronger
cards.ex_en: The breeze was freshening as night fell.
cards.ex_cn: 夜幕降临时风渐渐变强。

cards.gloss_en: on the ground beneath one's feet
cards.ex_en: The wet grass was slippery underfoot.
cards.ex_cn: 湿草在脚下很滑。

cards.gloss_en: sailing along close to the shore
cards.ex_en: We spent the day coasting the rocky shore.
cards.ex_cn: 我们花了一整天沿着礁石海岸航行。

cards.gloss_en: a very small stream
cards.ex_en: A clear rivulet ran through the wood.
cards.ex_cn: 一条清澈的小溪流过树林。

cards.gloss_en: expressing sorrow or complaint about
cards.ex_en: She sat bemoaning her lost fortune.
cards.ex_cn: 她坐着哀叹失去的财产。

cards.gloss_en: extremely happy and delighted
cards.ex_en: He was overjoyed to see his friend again.
cards.ex_cn: 再见到朋友他欣喜若狂。

cards.gloss_en: extremely dirty
cards.ex_en: His hands were filthy after the work.
cards.ex_cn: 干完活他的手脏得很。

cards.gloss_en: containers that hold or store things
cards.ex_en: The large baskets served as receivers for the grain.
cards.ex_cn: 那些大篮子用作盛谷物的容器。

cards.gloss_en: to hold back or trap so movement is hard
cards.ex_en: The tight net hampered the goat's legs.
cards.ex_cn: 紧绷的网困住了山羊的腿。

cards.gloss_en: a hidden pit dug to trap animals
cards.ex_en: The hunter dug a pitfall to catch the deer.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人挖了个陷坑捕鹿。

cards.gloss_en: movable frames used as fences or pens
cards.ex_en: They penned the sheep behind wooden hurdles.
cards.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把羊圈起来。

cards.gloss_en: clever and quick to understand
cards.ex_en: The sagacious old dog sensed danger at once.
cards.ex_cn: 那只机敏的老狗立刻察觉到危险。

cards.gloss_en: easy to control or train
cards.ex_en: After weeks the wild goat grew tractable.
cards.ex_cn: 几周后野山羊变得温顺了。

cards.gloss_en: grass and low green plants, used for grazing
cards.ex_en: The goats fed on the rich herbage.
cards.ex_cn: 山羊吃着丰美的青草。

cards.gloss_en: thought given beforehand to plan wisely
cards.ex_en: With little forecast he began the huge task.
cards.ex_cn: 他没多少深谋远虑就开始了这项大工程。

cards.gloss_en: tied to a fixed spot with a rope
cards.ex_en: He tethered the goat to a stake.
cards.ex_cn: 他把山羊拴在木桩上。

cards.gloss_en: making the soft cry of a sheep or goat
cards.ex_en: The lambs were bleating for their mother.
cards.ex_cn: 小羊羔咩咩地叫着找妈妈。

cards.gloss_en: milk and foods made from milk
cards.ex_en: The farm supplied the village with fresh dairy.
cards.ex_cn: 农场给村子供应新鲜乳品。

cards.gloss_en: attempts or tries at doing something
cards.ex_en: His first essays at cooking were a failure.
cards.ex_cn: 他初次尝试做饭以失败告终。

cards.gloss_en: dark underground prison cells
cards.ex_en: The prisoners were thrown into cold dungeons.
cards.ex_cn: 囚犯们被扔进阴冷的地牢。

cards.gloss_en: royal power and dignity; a title for a monarch
cards.ex_en: The crowd bowed before his majesty.
cards.ex_cn: 众人在陛下面前鞠躬。

cards.gloss_en: special; more than usual
cards.ex_en: He took especial care of the little cat.
cards.ex_cn: 他特别照顾那只小猫。

cards.gloss_en: goods taken by force, especially in war
cards.ex_en: The pirates hid their plunder in a cave.
cards.ex_cn: 海盗把掠夺物藏在山洞里。

cards.gloss_en: the service of waiting on or serving someone
cards.ex_en: The old servant was always in attendance on him.
cards.ex_cn: 老仆人总是随侍在他左右。

cards.gloss_en: a person's outfit and equipment
cards.ex_en: His strange equipage made the children stare.
cards.ex_cn: 他古怪的行头引得孩子们直盯着看。

cards.gloss_en: causing harm or damage
cards.ex_en: Too much sun can be hurtful to the skin.
cards.ex_cn: 过多的日晒会伤害皮肤。

cards.gloss_en: the upper parts of the legs above the knees
cards.ex_en: The long coat reached down to his thighs.
cards.ex_cn: 长外套一直垂到他的大腿。

cards.gloss_en: boots reaching to the calf or knee
cards.ex_en: The hunter wore rough leather buskins.
cards.ex_cn: 猎人穿着粗糙的皮长靴。

cards.gloss_en: leggings worn to keep mud off the legs
cards.ex_en: He tied spatterdashes over his boots.
cards.ex_cn: 他在靴子外绑上护腿。

cards.gloss_en: narrow strips of leather used as ties
cards.ex_en: The bundle was bound with leather thongs.
cards.ex_cn: 包裹用皮条捆着。

cards.gloss_en: large or long moustaches
cards.ex_en: The old sailor had thick grey moustachios.
cards.ex_cn: 老水手留着浓密的灰色大胡子。

cards.gloss_en: prepared and used land for growing crops
cards.ex_en: They cultivated the field every spring.
cards.ex_cn: 他们每年春天耕种这片田。

cards.gloss_en: formed a ring around something
cards.ex_en: A tall hedge encircled the garden.
cards.ex_cn: 一道高高的树篱环绕着花园。

cards.gloss_en: a thick soft cushion or couch
cards.ex_en: He rested on a squab made of soft skins.
cards.ex_cn: 他躺在用软皮做的软垫上。

cards.gloss_en: used as medicine or for healing
cards.ex_en: These leaves have medicinal value.
cards.ex_cn: 这些叶子有药用价值。

cards.gloss_en: full of risk or danger
cards.ex_en: Crossing the river was a hazardous task.
cards.ex_cn: 过河是件危险的事。

cards.gloss_en: extremely shocked and amazed
cards.ex_en: She stood thunderstruck at the terrible news.
cards.ex_cn: 听到噩耗她惊呆了。
